changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE host (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, hostname VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, os VARCHAR(255), arch VARCHAR(64), capabilities VARCHAR(4096) NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', generation BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, observed_generation BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN', created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);

CREATE TABLE agent (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, host_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES host(id), cert_identity VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE, version VARCHAR(64), last_seen TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, cert_fingerprint CHAR(64));

CREATE TABLE operation (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE, phase VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', error TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);

CREATE TABLE agent_enrollment (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, host_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES host(id), agent_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES agent(id), token_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE, expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, consumed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, created_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL REFERENCES panel_user(id), created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);

CREATE TABLE platform_settings (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, site_name VARCHAR(100), default_timezone VARCHAR(64), host_offline_after_seconds INTEGER, operation_retention_days INTEGER, updated_at BIGINT, updated_by UUID);
INSERT INTO platform_settings VALUES (1, 'NaNPanel', 'Asia/Shanghai', 90, 30, 0, NULL);

changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE host_network_inventory (host_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES host(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, interfaces CLOB NOT NULL, routes CLOB NOT NULL, observed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL);

changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE host_overlay_inventory (host_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES host(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, peer_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (peer_count BETWEEN 0 AND 100000), connected_peer_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (connected_peer_count BETWEEN 0 AND peer_count), p2p_peer_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (p2p_peer_count BETWEEN 0 AND connected_peer_count), relayed_peer_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (relayed_peer_count BETWEEN 0 AND connected_peer_count), observed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, CHECK (p2p_peer_count + relayed_peer_count = connected_peer_count));

changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE host_overlay_peer_snapshot (host_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES host(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, observed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE host_overlay_peer_inventory (host_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES host_overlay_peer_snapshot(host_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, peer_name VARCHAR(253) NOT NULL, connection_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (connection_status IN ('CONNECTED','DISCONNECTED','CONNECTING','UNKNOWN')), connection_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (connection_type IN ('P2P','RELAY','UNKNOWN')), PRIMARY KEY (host_id,peer_name), CHECK (connection_status='CONNECTED' OR connection_type='UNKNOWN'));

changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE agent_relay_status (relay_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, cluster_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, target_name VARCHAR(253) NOT NULL, epoch BIGINT NOT NULL, healthy BOOLEAN NOT NULL, healthy_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (healthy_count>=0), unhealthy_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (unhealthy_count>=0), last_seen TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, last_counted_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE dns_writer_lease (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id=1), owner_id VARCHAR(36), epoch BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (epoch>=0), lease_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE);
INSERT INTO dns_writer_lease (id,epoch) VALUES (1,0);

CREATE TABLE dns_managed_record (record_name VARCHAR(253) PRIMARY KEY, host_id UUID REFERENCES host(id), record_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, content VARCHAR(253) NOT NULL, ttl INTEGER NOT NULL, proxied BOOLEAN NOT NULL, state VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, detail VARCHAR(512), last_verified_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, content_changed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, switch_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (switch_count>=0), updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL);

changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE agent_gateway_fencing ADD COLUMN owner_id VARCHAR(128);
ALTER TABLE agent_gateway_fencing ADD COLUMN lease_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE;

changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE host_ssh_config (host_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES host(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, address VARCHAR(253) NOT NULL, port INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 22 CHECK (port BETWEEN 1 AND 65535), username VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, auth_method VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (auth_method IN ('PASSWORD', 'PRIVATE_KEY')), encrypted_credential VARBINARY NOT NULL, host_key_fingerprint VARCHAR(80), probed_host_key_fingerprint VARCHAR(80), probed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, created_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL REFERENCES panel_user(id), updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);

CREATE TABLE bastion_session (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, host_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES host(id), actor_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL REFERENCES panel_user(id), web_session_id UUID NOT NULL, reason VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, client_ip VARCHAR(64), target_address VARCHAR(253) NOT NULL, target_port INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (target_port BETWEEN 1 AND 65535), target_username VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, target_fingerprint VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'CLOSED', 'FAILED')), ticket_hash CHAR(64), ticket_expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, ticket_used_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_activity_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, finished_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, duration_ms BIGINT, bytes_in BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, bytes_out BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, recording_chunks INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (recording_chunks BETWEEN 0 AND 100000), terminal_columns INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 120 CHECK (terminal_columns BETWEEN 20 AND 500), terminal_rows INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 36 CHECK (terminal_rows BETWEEN 5 AND 200), exit_code INTEGER, failure_code VARCHAR(64));

CREATE TABLE bastion_recording_chunk (session_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES bastion_session(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, offset_ms BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (offset_ms >= 0), direction VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL CHECK (direction IN ('INPUT', 'OUTPUT')), payload VARBINARY NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (session_id, sequence));

CREATE TABLE bastion_command (session_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES bastion_session(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, occurred_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, encrypted_command VARBINARY NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (session_id, sequence));

changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE system_service_observation DROP COLUMN restart_allowed;
ALTER TABLE system_service_observation DROP COLUMN journal_read_allowed;

changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE kubernetes_service_inventory (source_id VARCHAR(80) PRIMARY KEY, namespace VARCHAR(63) NOT NULL, observed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, inventory_json VARCHAR(16777216) NOT NULL);

changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE kubernetes_service_probe (probe_key CHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, source_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, service_name VARCHAR(63) NOT NULL, endpoint_address VARCHAR(253) NOT NULL, port INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (port BETWEEN 1 AND 65535), protocol VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL CHECK (protocol = 'TCP'), outcome VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'TIMED_OUT', 'SKIPPED')), inventory_observed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, observed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX kubernetes_service_probe_source_time_idx ON kubernetes_service_probe(source_id, observed_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX kubernetes_service_probe_observed_idx ON kubernetes_service_probe(observed_at);

changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE network_provider_operation (id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY, provider_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, idempotency_key CHAR(64) NOT NULL, generation BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (generation > 0), state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('PLANNED','VALIDATED','APPLYING','APPLIED','VERIFIED','DRIFTED','COMPENSATING','COMPENSATED','UNKNOWN','FAILED')), plan_configuration CLOB NOT NULL, operation_id VARCHAR(36), detail VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, requested_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(provider_id,idempotency_key));
CREATE INDEX network_provider_operation_state_idx ON network_provider_operation(state, updated_at);

changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE topology_revision (id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY, generation BIGINT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (generation >= 0), snapshot VARCHAR(16777216) NOT NULL, updated_by VARCHAR(36), updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE topology_head (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), revision_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, generation BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (generation >= 0), snapshot VARCHAR(16777216) NOT NULL, updated_by VARCHAR(36), updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL);
INSERT INTO topology_revision VALUES ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 0, '{"nodes":[],"links":[]}', NULL, 0);

changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE kubernetes_managed_deployment (cluster_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES kubernetes_cluster(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, namespace VARCHAR(63) NOT NULL, deployment_name VARCHAR(63) NOT NULL, deployment_uid VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, ownership_token VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL REFERENCES panel_user(id), created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (cluster_id,namespace,deployment_name));

changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE kubernetes_cluster_node ADD COLUMN node_present BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE;

changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE host_kubernetes_runtime_discovery (host_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES host(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, detected BOOLEAN NOT NULL, kubelet_running BOOLEAN NOT NULL, api_server_local BOOLEAN NOT NULL, runtime_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (runtime_kind IN ('NONE','K3S','KUBERNETES')), observed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, CHECK ((detected AND kubelet_running AND runtime_kind IN ('K3S','KUBERNETES')) OR (NOT detected AND NOT kubelet_running AND runtime_kind='NONE')));

changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE k3s_rollout_plan (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, cluster_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES kubernetes_cluster(id), target_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, reason VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('DRAFT','RUNNING','VERIFYING','SUCCEEDED','FAILED','UNKNOWN')), active_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (active_ordinal >= 0), error_code VARCHAR(64), error_message VARCHAR(1000), requested_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL REFERENCES panel_user(id), created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, finished_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE);

CREATE TABLE k3s_rollout_step (plan_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES k3s_rollout_plan(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0), host_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES host(id), node_uid VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, node_name VARCHAR(253) NOT NULL, role VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('server','agent')), expected_generation BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (expected_generation >= 1), state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('PENDING','SUBMITTING','RUNNING','VERIFYING','SUCCEEDED','FAILED','UNKNOWN')), idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE, operation_id UUID REFERENCES operation(id), error_code VARCHAR(64), error_message VARCHAR(1000), created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, finished_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, PRIMARY KEY (plan_id,ordinal), UNIQUE (plan_id,host_id));

changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE k3s_install_plan (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, target_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, server_url VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, reason VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, state VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('DRAFT','RUNNING','AWAITING_CLUSTER_REGISTRATION','AWAITING_NODE_MAPPING','SUCCEEDED','FAILED','UNKNOWN')), active_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (active_ordinal >= 0), cluster_id UUID REFERENCES kubernetes_cluster(id), encrypted_token VARBINARY NOT NULL, error_code VARCHAR(64), error_message VARCHAR(1000), requested_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL REFERENCES panel_user(id), created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, finished_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE);

CREATE TABLE k3s_install_step (plan_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES k3s_install_plan(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0), host_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES host(id), role VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('server','agent')), expected_generation BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (expected_generation >= 1), state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('PENDING','SUBMITTING','RUNNING','VERIFYING','SUCCEEDED','FAILED','UNKNOWN')), idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE, operation_id UUID REFERENCES operation(id), error_code VARCHAR(64), error_message VARCHAR(1000), created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, finished_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, PRIMARY KEY (plan_id,ordinal), UNIQUE (plan_id,host_id));

changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE cluster_provider_operation (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, provider_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, cluster_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES kubernetes_cluster(id), idempotency_key CHAR(64) NOT NULL, request_fingerprint CHAR(64) NOT NULL, generation BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (generation >= 0), operation VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT cluster_provider_operation_state_check CHECK (state IN ('PLANNED','VALIDATED','DRIFTED','FAILED')), plan_configuration CLOB NOT NULL, detail VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, requested_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL REFERENCES panel_user(id), created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL, UNIQUE (provider_id,idempotency_key));
CREATE INDEX cluster_provider_operation_cluster_idx ON cluster_provider_operation(cluster_id, updated_at);

changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE cluster_provider_credential (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, provider_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, cluster_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES kubernetes_cluster(id), purpose VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, encrypted_material VARBINARY NOT NULL, expires_at BIGINT, revoked_at BIGINT, created_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL REFERENCES panel_user(id), created_at BIGINT NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX cluster_provider_credential_scope_idx ON cluster_provider_credential(provider_id, cluster_id, created_at);

changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE cluster_provider_operation DROP CONSTRAINT cluster_provider_operation_state_check;

ALTER TABLE cluster_provider_operation ADD CONSTRAINT cluster_provider_operation_state_check CHECK (state IN ('PLANNED','VALIDATED','DRIFTED','EXECUTING','AWAITING_NODE_REGISTRATION','SUCCEEDED','FAILED','UNKNOWN'));
ALTER TABLE cluster_provider_operation ALTER COLUMN state TYPE VARCHAR(40);
ALTER TABLE cluster_provider_operation ADD COLUMN host_operation_id UUID REFERENCES operation(id);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX cluster_provider_host_operation_unique ON cluster_provider_operation(host_operation_id);

changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE kubernetes_application_packet_capture (capture_id UUID PRIMARY KEY, application_id UUID NOT NULL, revision_id UUID NOT NULL, generation BIGINT NOT NULL, link_id UUID NOT NULL, capture_point VARCHAR(128), operation_id UUID, idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, pcapng VARBINARY, packet_count INTEGER, captured_bytes INTEGER, truncated BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, detail VARCHAR(512), created_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, started_at BIGINT NOT NULL, completed_at BIGINT, expires_at BIGINT NOT NULL);

changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE reverse_proxy_site (site_id UUID PRIMARY KEY, host_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES host(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, domain VARCHAR(253) NOT NULL, listen_address VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL, listen_port INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (listen_port BETWEEN 1 AND 65535), upstream_port INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (upstream_port BETWEEN 1 AND 65535), health_path VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL DEFAULT '/', tls_name VARCHAR(32), state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('DRAFT','APPLIED','DISABLED','FAILED')), operation_id UUID REFERENCES operation(id), created_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL REFERENCES panel_user(id), created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reverse_proxy_site_endpoint_unique ON reverse_proxy_site(host_id, domain, listen_port);
CREATE INDEX reverse_proxy_site_host_idx ON reverse_proxy_site(host_id, created_at DESC);

changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE panel_role (role_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, builtin BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE panel_role_permission (role_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL REFERENCES panel_role(role_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, permission VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (role_id, permission));

changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE alert_rule (rule_id UUID PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, condition_kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (condition_kind IN ('HOST_NOT_ONLINE','HELPER_UNAVAILABLE','SERVICE_INACTIVE')), host_id UUID REFERENCES host(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, unit_name VARCHAR(255), severity VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (severity IN ('WARNING','CRITICAL')), enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, created_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL REFERENCES panel_user(id), created_at BIGINT NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX alert_rule_enabled_idx ON alert_rule(enabled, created_at DESC);

changeSet.author: nanpanel
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE host_container_deployment (host_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES host(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, container_name VARCHAR(63) NOT NULL, image VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, host_port INTEGER CHECK (host_port BETWEEN 1 AND 65535), container_port INTEGER CHECK (container_port BETWEEN 1 AND 65535), created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (host_id, container_name));
